data.gender_notes: Hebel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew havel, meaning breath or transience. In the Bible, Hebel is the name of the third son of Adam and Eve, and the name of the first man to die. The name Hebel carries the meaning “Breath, transience” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hebel usually hope their child will grow to embody breath, transience and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the fleeting nature of life and the importance of cherishing each moment.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hebel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
